data.long_meaning: One who has achieved or brings success, prosperity, or abundance. The name Faaiz carries the meaning “Achiever, Successful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Faaiz usually hope their child will grow to embody achiever, successful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Faaiz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Achiever, Successful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faaiz total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

The name Faaiz is also associated with one who is successful in the soul and intellect. In Arabic, the name Faaiz is written with the letter fa and the letter za, and is pronounced as Faa-eez. The name Faaiz is a popular name in many Muslim cultures and is considered a good omen for success and prosperity.
